tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search AI music artists in the TopAIMuza.pl catalogue by name (typos tolerated) and/or genre. Returns up to 25 artists with genres, TopAI chart position and profile link. With only a genre, artists are ordered by chart position. / Wyszukuje artystów muzyki AI po nazwie lub gatunku.

tools.name: top_ranking
tools.description: Top of the TopAI chart of Polish AI music on TopAIMuza.pl (the same places as topaimuza.pl/ranking/topai/), optionally within one genre: place, movement since yesterday, artist, genres, real platform figures (YouTube, Spotify, YouTube Music) with read dates and profile link. Up to 25 places. / Czołó

tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search track pages on TopAIMuza.pl by title, optionally by one artist. Returns title, artist, release date and links to the track page and the artist profile. Up to 25 tracks. / Wyszukuje utwory po tytule (opcjonalnie u jednego artysty) z linkiem do karty utworu.

tools.name: new_releases
tools.description: Newest track pages in the TopAIMuza.pl catalogue of Polish AI music, optionally within one genre: title, artist, release date and links to the track page and the artist profile. Up to 25 tracks. / Najnowsze utwory w katalogu TopAIMuza.pl, opcjonalnie w jednym gatunku, z linkami do kart.

tools.name: list_genres
tools.description: Genres of the TopAIMuza.pl catalogue (e.g. disco polo, rap, pop, rock) with the number of artist profiles and a link to each genre page. / Gatunki w katalogu z liczbą artystów i linkiem do strony gatunku.
